claims.statement: Athletic Brewing participated in an AI Bootcamp.
claims.quote: What we did The marketing team at Athletic Brewing participated in a two-hour AI Bootcamp that provided a clear understanding of AI's potential, as well as practical ways to start applying AI immediately. While every bootcamp introduces key AI concepts, examples and insights from industry leaders, and best practices, each bootcamp ends with customized activity. For Athletic Brewing, participants were broken into teams and challenged to research, plan, and pitch a new product line within 45 minutes. Each pitch had to include a new product concept, name, branding, a well-defined audience segment, and an AI-generated marketing campaign.
